summary: Superior National Forest lookout in Lake County, listed as removed; no build date, height or history found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Lake County booklet lists it as removed; Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone.

evidence.supports: Lake County, Superior National Forest, site listed as 62N-86W-14
Arrow row: coordinates, Superior National Forest, removed
booklet codes the owner as USFS
Arrow longitude 91.31 west, on the Arrow row of the booklet
Arrow named with Insula and Malberg as lakes with fire towers southeast of the Fernberg Lookout
evidence.quote: Other old fire towers sat southeast of the Fernberg along lakes whose names you may recognize: Insula, Malberg, and Arrow all had fire towers at one point or another

sources.title: Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers: Lake County
Smoke On the Horizon: How Fire Towers Changed BWCA History

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two booklet rows, the FFLA list and one article mention. No build date, height, design or history beyond removal was found in the sources read. Next step if anyone pursues it: the MnDOT historic context study 'Fire Lookout Towers in Minnesota, 1900-1970' (lrl.mn.gov catalogue record), which was not opened.
